description: An ARQ C_PDU whose TTL expires part way through is rejected, and its remaining D_PDUs, one failed and one never sent, go as empty DROP PDUs so the windows stay in step.
note: Link setup as cas/make-caller-accepted: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ, its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 makes the CAS call the peer (Ed4 request out at 75000, sent at 80550), and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link with the 16-bit family (B-0219, B-0142): window edges TX LWE 0, TX UWE 65535, RX LWE 0, RX UWE 65535 (C-0782, C-0787). The held U_PDU goes down as an ARQ C_PDU (A-0194) and dts.ttd runs to its TTD (C-1050), 59000 ms. The burst ends at 92000 with the EOT prediction at 96000 ahead and data queued: csma.vdcd_end; at 96000 LBT rule 1 (the burst was addressed only to us, K-0067) and contention, 12000 ms (second draw). The S_UNIDATA_REQUEST asks for TTL 75 (150 s), so the TTD is 150000 (A-0089). The 18-byte C_PDU (U_PDU 'twelve bytes') is three 6-byte segments and dts.max_window is 2. At 108000 FSNs 0 and 1 go (as dts-arq/window-full-waits); the third waits for the window (C-0775). At 126000 the ACK-ONLY has RX LWE 0 and bitmap 0x01: FSN 1 acknowledged, FSN 0 failed (C-0908); dts.ack_wait stops, and the window stays full (TX LWE 0, TX UWE 1). The burst ends at 127000; csma.vdcd_end to 131000, LBT rule 1, contention 45000 ms. At 150000 dts.ttd expires: the C_PDU is not to be sent any more (C-0857) and is rejected to the CAS with reason TTL expired (C-0859; the SIS answers nothing until P6-1). Part of it is sent, so we use the DROP method (C-0858, C-0860): every D_PDU of it still unacknowledged goes as a DROP PDU, and so does the segment never sent (C-0862, C-1124). No timer is left to run, and the MAC is still contending. At 176000 FSN 0 is retransmitted (C-0904) as a DROP PDU: DROP C_PDU set, no segment and segment size 0 (C-0180, C-0182, C-0183), C_PDU START kept, TX WIN LWE; 19 bytes, one block, EOT 10. The unsent segment cannot go yet (window full). At 191000 RX LWE 2 acknowledges FSN 0 (C-0181, C-0861): dts.ack_wait stops and the window opens. The burst ends at 192000: csma.vdcd_end to 196000, LBT rule 1, contention 36000 ms (fourth draw). At 232000 the third segment goes as a DROP PDU with FSN 2: C_PDU END, both TX WIN flags. At 246000 RX LWE 3 acknowledges it; the C_PDU was already rejected, so nothing is confirmed, and dts.ttd stays stopped. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080). Fill (C-1154): no transmission here has room in its last block for a copy of its ACK-ONLY (15 or more bytes) or for a PADDING D_PDU (11 bytes), so each is zero filled.  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
